Keys match the form's own submit payload exactly (createConnectorSubmissionAction),
recovered from the shipped PlatformSubmissionForm bundle and re-verified 2026-09-21.
Run `pnpm submission:validate` before pasting. It applies Muse's own client-side rules.

useCases:
Book a haircut on Thursday afternoon near me.
Find a plumber who can come tomorrow for a leak under the kitchen sink.
My AC died — get someone out this week for under $300.

Pay the deposit on my massage booking.
limits: United States only at launch, in metropolitan areas where a connected booking platform has coverage. No Porter account or subscription is needed; the user connects the booking platform their chosen business already uses, and authorises it once. Porter covers beauty and home services only: hair, barbering, nails, waxing, massage, facials, plus plumbing, HVAC, electrical, cleaning, handyman, appliance repair, pest control and lawn care. Porter does not handle medical, health, legal or financial services. Rate limits are 60 requests per minute per user. Some businesses require a deposit before an appointment is held. Home-service jobs that need a site visit return a quote rather than a price, and the appointment stays pending until the business schedules it.
extraNotes:
Porter is a multi-business aggregator, not a single business's booking page. It integrates with the booking and field-service platforms that local businesses already run — Square Appointments and Jobber at launch, with Vagaro, Boulevard, Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Mindbody and MoeGo designed for — and normalises them behind one tool surface. We are stating this plainly because the connector's scope is wider than one merchant.

The tool surface is nine tools and nothing else: search_providers, get_availability, get_quote, create_booking, reschedule_booking, cancel_booking, list_my_bookings, pay_or_deposit and message_provider. There are no undisclosed functions and no undeclared endpoints.

Bounded action range: every tool that books, cancels with a fee, or charges money is two-phase. The first call changes nothing and returns a structured summary carrying the price, the frequency, the cancellation terms and any penalty. It commits only when the agent returns a signed, single-use confirmation token. The maximum single transaction is USD 2,000, and any amount at or above USD 200 is flagged in the summary as needing explicit approval. Porter never enters card details; payments run through Stripe Connect against a saved payment method, and Porter holds opaque references only.

Business-supplied text (names, descriptions, messages) is treated as untrusted data and sanitised before it reaches the agent. A reviewer demo mode is available that exercises the full lifecycle against realistic sample businesses without touching a real merchant account — see the documentation URL for credentials.
